deploybot: PROD deploy started by @alice — tag=v3.6.2 commit=9f2a3b1 environment=prod change_window=02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary rollout policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks. Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/prod-deploys Deploy command: `./deploy --env=prod --tag=v3.6.2 --canary=10`
alice: Copy — monitoring dashboards up, I triggered the rollout. Please ping if any canary alarms. :eyes:
ben: Any DB migration with this release?
dmitri: No schema changes, only a small config toggle for KV cache TTL. Verified in staging.
sre-oncall: I'll watch latency and 5xxs. Recommend holding at 50% for 10m if any tail latency spikes.
deploybot: Canary at 10% — started. Observability: https://telemetry/internal/dashboards/deploys?tag=v3.6.2 Logs: https://logs/internal?q=9f2a3b1
ops-runner: Noted. I'll also keep an eye on GPU pool saturation for Dedicated customers.
deploybot: Canary progressed to 50% — time=+8m. Health checks: OK. No spike in 5xx. Average p50 latency +6ms.
dmitri: Saw a small spike in KV hit rate drop around +6m, but cache warmed by +9m. Nothing alarming.
alice: Good. Proceed to 100% when safe.
sre-oncall: Hold 50% for one more 5m window to let autoscaler settle.
deploybot: Rollout paused at 50% per SLO hold. Paused by automated policy (reason=stability-check).
ben: I see a transient error in one canary pod: `ERROR temp: conn reset` — looks network blip.
sre-oncall: Confirmed, network flap on us-east-1 between 2:12-2:13 UTC. No user impact. Recommend resume.
deploybot: Resuming rollout to 100% — proceeding.
deploybot: Rollout complete — 100% traffic shifted to tag=v3.6.2. Total duration=16m. No rollbacks.
release-manager: Noted — tag pinned in release registry. Release notes draft: https://docs/internal/releases/v3.6.2 Please add a short blurb about cache TTL tweak.
alice: Added notes and updated changelog. Shipping post-deploy smoke: `curl -s https://api.prod/health | jq .status` -> "ok"
ops-runner: GPU utilization stable, no spikes.
dmitri: Running a quick eval on a sample prompt set — outputs look consistent.
sre-oncall: Observability gate passed. Closing the window. :white_check_mark:
deploybot: PROD deploy finished by @alice — tag=v3.6.2 commit=9f2a3b1 status=success artifacts=pushed pin=release-registry/v3.6.2
alice: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up on the minor network incident in the postmortem channel with logs. :thumbsup:
release-manager: Will schedule the external release note email for 07:00 UTC.
ops-runner: If anything crops up overnight ping #eng-oncall.
sre-oncall: A few followups noted, creating tickets for KV TTL telemetry and cross-region netflap alerts.
alice: Great, closing thread.
